source: User-supplied screen recordings plus existing v6 source package

features.details: Independent permission mode per app; default/global mode remains separate.
Displays app-specific local preference and explicitly unverified provider scopes.
Dedicated dependency view; missing dependencies/services/version constraints are not supplied / not verified.
Updates a selected app permission mode in local browser state only.
Opens file picker and stores filename/size/MIME/lastModified only; file bytes not uploaded.
Temporary messages are stored separately, and can be saved to history or discarded.
Enter sends; Shift+Enter leaves multiline entry available.
Checkbox confirmation only; no identity or age verification performed.
Local status toggle only; no contact details collected or linked.

limitations: No real app permissions or dependencies inspected
No AI inference or live web search
No Android-native security or identity verification
